title: NDA draft
brief: A complete, ready-to-sign mutual NDA between two fictional French companies — Atelier Nord SAS and Galerie Lumière SARL — exploring a retail partnership; French law, drafted in English, with definitions, carve-outs, a three-year term, remedies, a no-solicit option flagged in a margin note, and signature blocks; preceded by a five-line how-to-use note and followed by six short annotations explaining the drafting choices, with a demo disclaimer.
da: Pure typography — stark white, black EB Garamond, numbered clauses with hanging indents, discreet gray margin annotations, one deep-red DRAFT stamp.
